retained_rows.assessment_basis: The reported robotaxi collision injured two pedestrians. The driving mode, active automation stack and control telemetry are not available, so the evidence does not resolve the AI system’s role in the collision or its safety-control outcome.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Physical injury in a robotaxi occurrence makes the autonomous system’s safety role materially relevant, while that role remains unresolved.
